title: HECM Loan Agreement Rider: Changing the Payout Plan
content:
**Section 1 — Permission.** A borrower may change the payout plan of a Home Equity Conversion Mortgage (HECM) only where the plan permits changes after closing. The HECM Fixed-Rate Single Disbursement is closed-end, can never change plan, and no adjustable loan may change into it, so such requests are declined with the reason plan not eligible.

**Section 2 — Conditions.** A plan change is processed only while the loan status is active. A plan change is processed only against a payment plan change request on file for that loan whose request status is submitted and which was submitted through the signed written channel bearing the signature of every borrower on the note, every borrower's signature being needed per the plan's signed-request requirement. A requested term for a term-based plan must lie between the target plan's shortest and longest term inclusive, otherwise the request is declined with the reason plan not eligible.

**Section 3 — Order of processing on the handling date.** When the current plan pays scheduled payments, the present value of the payments not yet made returns to the available line as one line release; then, when the target plan pays scheduled payments, the committed amount leaves the available line as one line commitment; then the plan, payment and term on the loan record are updated; then the plan's plan change fee is charged as one plan change fee entry.

**Section 4 — Rates.** The monthly rate for every payment computation is one twelfth of the sum of the loan's expected rate and the plan's annual mortgage insurance premium rate, and payments are treated as made at the start of each month.

**Section 5 — Release amount.** *Retired, no longer in force and superseded by the current basis:* the clause fixing the release amount as the present value of the remaining scheduled payments at the monthly rate, rounded half up to the cent, the remaining payments being the term less the term payments made for a term-based plan, and for a tenure-based plan twelve times the difference between the tenure age horizon and the age in whole years, on the first day of the month the change takes effect, of the youngest borrower or eligible non-borrowing spouse on the loan.

**Section 6 — Committed amount.** For a change into the Tenure or Term plan the whole available line after any release is committed. *Retired, no longer in force and superseded by the current basis:* the clause that for a change into a Modified plan the committed amount is the requested amount on the request, which may not exceed the available line after any release, otherwise the request is declined with the reason insufficient available line.

**Section 7 — New scheduled payment.** *Retired, no longer in force and superseded by the current basis:* the clause fixing the new scheduled payment as the payment the committed amount buys at the monthly rate over the payment count, rounded half up to the cent, the payment count being the requested term for a term-based plan and, for a tenure-based plan, twelve times the difference between the tenure age horizon and that same youngest age.

**Section 8 — Effect.** A change into the HECM Line of Credit sets the scheduled payment to 0.00, the term to 0 months and leaves no first payment month; any other change sets the first payment month to the month after the handling month, per the plan's effective-date rule. Each request is processed at most once, and on success its request status becomes processed.

superseded_clauses: The release amount is the current scheduled_payment_amount times (1 + monthly rate) times (1 - (1 + monthly rate) to the power of minus the remaining payments) divided by the monthly rate, rounded half up to the cent; the remaining payments are scheduled_payment_term_months less hecm_msr_term_payments_made for a term-based plan, and for a tenure-based plan twelve times the difference between tenure_age_horizon_years and the age in whole years, on the first day of the month the change takes effect, of the youngest borrower or eligible non-borrowing spouse on the loan.

for a change into a Modified plan the committed amount is the requested_amount on the request, which may not exceed the available line after any release, otherwise the request is declined with reason insufficient_available_line.

The new scheduled payment is the committed amount times the monthly rate divided by ((1 + monthly rate) times (1 - (1 + monthly rate) to the power of minus the payment count)), rounded half up to the cent, where the payment count is the requested term for a term-based plan and, for a tenure-based plan, twelve times the difference between tenure_age_horizon_years and that same youngest age.
